Title: How the pieces fit — Lily Design System

Description: The layers of Lily and what each owns: headless components, helpers, themes, examples, and skills — and when to reach for each.

# How the pieces fit

Lily is a stack of layers. Each owns one job and nothing else, so you can adopt one without the others.

## The layers

- **Catalog** — 583 named components in `components.tsv`, each with a slug, a root HTML element, ARIA and a keyboard contract. It is the shared vocabulary every other layer is built from. Reach for it to learn what exists and what it is called.
- **Headless** — the catalog as unstyled, accessible components in your framework: HTML, Svelte, React, Vue, Angular, Blazor, Nunjucks, Web Components and Alpine.js. It owns semantic markup, ARIA, focus and keyboard behaviour; it owns no colour, spacing or text. Reach for it when you build your own interface.
- **Helpers** — packages that each own one whole interaction: the pickers (theme, locale, text size, motion, share, search, links, menu, settings, date and time), `picker-bar`, and the data grid, kanban board, calendar, Gantt chart and filter. Reach for a helper when the interaction is the product, not just a part.
- **Themes** — 57 plain stylesheets that dress the class hooks. Reach for one to see the components styled, or as the start of your own.
- **Examples** — complete styled apps, one per framework, with a live page for every component. Reach for them to see the system working end to end before you commit.
- **Skills** — instructions for AI coding agents, one set per framework layer. Reach for them when an agent writes the code.

## Which one do I need?

- I want to try it: open an [example](https://lilydesignsystem.com/examples/).
- I am building an interface: use the headless package for my framework, then a theme or my own CSS.
- I need a date field, a language switch or a data grid: use that helper.
- I want an agent to write it: install the skill for my framework.

The rules each layer follows are in the [specification](https://github.com/LilyDesignSystem/lily-design-system/blob/main/spec/index.md).
